body: Phase 5 landed, then three defects were found by looking at it on macOS rather than by testing it. main is now 128e0b4.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Merged since the last park:** 158 (photo toolbar), 159 (footer), 160 (rail and sheet removal) closed the phase 5 stack the previous next_step named. Then 161 (toolbar alignment and footer dead band), 162 (photo frame across re-decode), 163 (keep the spec folder out of git and the analyzer).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Defect 1, toolbar marks top-aligned.** `_PhotoToolbarControl` imposed its 28pt tap target with a `ConstrainedBox` minimum and never centred the child, so every mark sat at the top of its box and the side glyphs stretched to 28pt against their own 18. A minimum constraint propagates into the child as a layout constraint instead of acting as space around it. The tell was the separators, which are direct `Row` children and were therefore centred correctly. Fixed with `Center(widthFactor: 1, heightFactor: 1)` inside the padding; the bar rect was byte-identical before and after, so placement was untouched.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Defect 2, composer dead band.** 131.4pt of blank paper between the last line of text and the footer, and the blur stopped short of the modal's bottom edge. Same shape of error: page bottom padding applied outside the scroll view instead of inside it. Replaced with a `bottomInset` threaded through `NoteEditorConfig` into `RenderPhotoCanvas`, so the reserved band is scroll slack rather than a viewport inset. Surface bottom moved 856 to 870, dead band 131.4 to 0.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Defect 3, photo flashes white on every resize step.** Ran through the interphase bug pathway, implemented through mitosis. Two independent blank paths, not one. `Image.file(cacheWidth:)` wraps the provider in `ResizeImage`, so each 64px decode bucket is a different provider key, and `_ImageState` blanks the widget on a provider change when `gaplessPlayback` is false, which is the default. Second path, found by the spec reviewer and then verified: `_content()` swapped widget shape between the unresolved and resolved states, so `Widget.canUpdate` returned false and the whole `Image` subtree unmounted. Every existing test memoized the resolver before the first pump, so the suite could never have seen it. Fixed with `gaplessPlayback: true` plus a `_MediaResolution` holder that keeps one shape throughout.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Verification.** Full local gate green at each step: analyze clean, 1938 tests, 39 goldens. Owner ran the app on macOS and confirmed the toolbar, the footer and the resize.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Two investigation lessons worth not re-learning.** A probe worktree must be run from inside its own root; `flutter test "$PROBE/..."` launched from the main repo resolves `package:field_notes` to unmodified source and the probe appears to refute a cause that is real. And `RenderImage.image` is the only assertion that proves what is actually painted, which needs `tester.runAsync` for a `FileImage` decode to complete.U+000AU+000AU+002A*One honest gap.** A second probe, for the stale-frame-on-swap path, timed out at ten minutes twice and was abandoned. That behaviour is asserted from Flutter's own `gaplessPlayback` doc comment, not from a run here.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Closed by inspection, not a real risk.** The `ValueKey(file.path)` on the image cannot hold a stale frame, because `relPathForId` shards a content-hash blob id into the path, so one path cannot ever hold different bytes.U+000A
